projects.shortDescription: A refined brand identity created for León Bérgara, translating the world of contemporary eyewear into a distinctive and expressive visual language.

description.text: León Bérgara is a Brazilian eyewear brand shaped by a contemporary interpretation of Italian elegance. The visual identity was designed to feel refined, timeless and distinctive, moving away from the obvious visual codes commonly associated with eyewear.

The creative direction began with ideas of architecture, light, transparency and glass, leading to the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II in Milan as one of the main visual references. Its iconic glass dome inspired the brand symbol, which was simplified into a precise and recognizable form designed to work seamlessly across different scales — from larger brand applications to the smallest details on eyewear.

The identity combines refined typography, an earthy and sophisticated color palette, balanced compositions and carefully crafted graphic elements, creating a visual system that feels both classic and contemporary. Warm, understated tones bring depth and elegance to the brand while allowing the eyewear and photography to remain at the center of the experience.

Every element was developed to reinforce a sense of clarity, precision and quiet sophistication, resulting in a cohesive identity that translates naturally across packaging, printed materials, digital communication and product applications.
